# Backoffice 1.0.64

**Live numbers**
- Dashboard, Live exposure, Clients and Margin now update the moment a price moves, the same way the terminal does.

**Funds**
- One Funds window per account: Deposit, Withdraw, Adjustment, Credit, Transfer and History, with the balance, credit and equity on top. Tabs you cannot use are not shown.
- Transfers are only between accounts of the same client. A client with no other account has no Transfer tab.

**Trades and orders**
- Void a closed trade from its menu (a manager asks, an admin confirms).
- Limit and stop orders on the dealing ticket and on the chart.

**Settings and security**
- Settings: session timeout (ends a session after that long with no activity), how long the audit log is kept, auto-approve withdrawals up to an amount, and whether hedging is allowed.
- Security: password change interval and the list of allowed IP addresses. Staff devices, IP addresses and recent sign-ins show on a staff member.

**Risk and trading halt**
- Risk radar: flag an account, whitelist it or add a note.
- Trading halt: an incident log of every halt, close-only and sign-out of all clients, with who, when, how long and why. Halting, close-only and signing out all clients now ask for a one-line reason.

**Clearer screens**
- KYC is the one word everywhere: Not verified, Pending, Verified, Rejected.
- Groups list shows how each group is routed.
- Test accounts can be marked, and show a TEST tag.

# Backoffice 1.0.62 (hotfix, 2026-10-06)

Owner asked for "1.0.61.1"; Velopack accepts only a 3-part SemVer2 version (vpk refuses 1.0.61.1), so the hotfix ships as
1.0.62. The planned step releases move to 1.0.63 / 1.0.64 / 1.0.65.

- Live tables no longer blink (Dashboard, Clients, Margin, Risk radar, Exposure): a refresh updates the rows already on
  screen by id; only the cells whose value changed flash and repaint; nothing goes blank between refreshes; a failed read
  keeps the rows on screen.
- Staff Deposit / Withdraw: never blocked or warned on the ID check (KYC); a staff-recorded withdrawal waiting for a
  second admin is not blocked on KYC either. Deposits & withdrawals: a client's withdrawal without approved KYC can be
  approved / paid (a "KYC not verified" tag only); a server refusal is shown in the window.
- The credential card keeps COPY ALL DETAILS (and click-to-copy per value).
- Start-up: no "checking" box; the sign-in page opens at once and the check runs in the background; only a revoked /
  not-active build is stopped.
- UI sweep: Source feed wording on Feed health, no Copy items, unbuilt items hidden, wording (Admin, Settings, Company,
  Book P/L).

# Backoffice 1.0.61

**Passwords**
- Password reset: one line, "✓ New password sent to {e-mail}", with **SHOW PASSWORD** and **DONE**. Showing the password is recorded in the audit log (who and when).
- Not e-mailed: one line with the reason, and the password card is shown.
- New **Set password…**: type the password yourself; the rule shows as you type; "E-mail it to the client" is on by default.
- Every new password (reset, new account, first staff password) shows one details card: Account, Name, Group · Live / Demo, Server, Web login, Password, a copy icon on each row and **COPY ALL DETAILS**.

**Internal accounts**
- New **Mark as internal account** (admins only) for the company's own, house and test accounts. They show an **INTERNAL** chip.
- Internal accounts are never e-mailed a password, and are left out of client totals, the Dashboard, Live exposure, the dealing desk scope, the risk radar and reports.

**Deposits and withdrawals**
- One **Deposit / Withdraw…** window with DEPOSIT and WITHDRAW tabs (Account menu), and one **NEW DEPOSIT / WITHDRAWAL…** button on Deposits & withdrawals.
- A refusal is shown inside the window, e.g. "Withdrawals need an approved ID check" with **Open ID check**.
- A staff deposit or withdrawal shows on the Dashboard within about a second.

**Clients**
- **Resend verification e-mail** for a client whose portal e-mail is not verified (Account menu, account applications, ID checks).

**Groups**
- The Groups list fits its rows, with a drag bar to Group pricing; your position is remembered.

**Sign-in and updates**
- The sign-in window shows the company's name and logo.
- No more "Checking this installation" box at start: the check runs in the background. A retired build still shows a clear refusal with an update.
- Updates install by themselves before sign-in. While signed in, an update installs when you close the backoffice, or at once with **Restart now**.

**Live connection**
- The price stream no longer drops every 10 to 30 minutes. A short drop is silent; each drop and its reason are written to `%APPDATA%\VyxTrader\backoffice-stream.log`.

**Wording**
- Dialogs, confirms and messages are shorter.

Release check before publishing: deploy the web branch `web/staff-resend-verification` and apply its database migration (`account_is_internal`) first. Until then, Set password, Show password, the internal flag and Resend verification e-mail say "server update needed"; everything else works.

# Backoffice 1.0.39

**Withdrawals need approved KYC**
- A withdrawal can only be approved when the account's KYC (or its portal client's) is approved. Such requests show KYC NOT APPROVED; reject them or approve the KYC first. Deposits and trading are not affected.
- Your approve or reject note is kept apart from the client's own note (shown as BROKER: …), and the client is told the outcome.
- Only the person who marked a withdrawal can cancel the mark.
- The tiles on Deposits and withdrawals count every request, not only the latest 200.

**Groups: apply leverage to existing accounts**
- A group's menu has "Apply leverage to existing accounts". It first shows every account that would change, with its margin level now and after.
- Accounts that would fall under stop-out are left out unless you tick the box to include them.

**Dealing: coverage account**
- The coverage account is set on the server (broker admins only), and can't be switched while it holds open hedge positions.

**Accounts**
- New account: a custom leverage needs a broker admin or the Account finance permission; you can pick the account type.
- Account requests: approving lets you choose the group, the leverage and the account type.

**Other**
- Account types: edit the flat pricing (markup, commission, swaps, swap-free); needs the Pricing permission.
- Mirror rules: re-enable a rule whose kill switch tripped, and edit its caps.
- Symbols: a stop level column (minimum stop loss / take profit distance, in points).
- Live exposure: a partial close must be a valid lot size and cannot leave less than the minimum open.

**Nothing fails silently any more**
- If a screen cannot load something, it now says so: a message with what failed, and tiles show NO ACCESS or UNAVAILABLE instead of 0 or an empty list.
- "Close all positions" lists any positions that did not close, and why.
- IB payouts list any payments that failed, and why.

**Links go to the right record**
- Audit log, notification and dashboard links open the right screen on the right record: risk and dealing entries open Risk and Dealing, a new lead opens that lead, a pending order is highlighted in the dealing queue.

**Client 360**
- Closed trades show the client's own full history, with open and close times.
- The broker's coverage (hedge) account is marked and offers no client actions.
- The account statement marks any section that could not be loaded.
- Password reset says clearly whether the new password was e-mailed or must be handed over.

**Lists that were cut off**
- Trade history and the audit log have a date range, and say when a list shows only the latest rows. The audit log has LOAD OLDER.
- Report CSV exports only the rows the date range shows.

- The dealing activity feed includes your own accept, reject and requote decisions, in the right order across midnight.
- Switching to auto-fill reports which waiting orders were filled or skipped.
- The Trading halt screen shows and sets close-only per group; its actions work with one click.
- Reverse asks for a reason, which goes to the approver.

- Deposits and withdrawals appear the moment a client files them.
- Leads: notes can be edited, and converting a lead no longer loads every account.
- KYC: PDF documents open in your PDF viewer; address proof can be viewed.
- Settings show negative-balance protection and max slippage; Account types say whether per-symbol pricing is applied.
- Groups: swap-free can be set back to "inherit".

# Backoffice 1.0.32

**Group routing is simpler**
- Each group's routing now decides where its orders go:
  - B-book groups fill automatically.
  - Dealing desk groups go to the dealer while the desk is on, and fill automatically while it is off.
  - Reverse trading groups fill automatically and are copied by the copy rule.
  - A-book groups take no accounts until a liquidity provider is connected.
- The group form says what the chosen routing does.
- Dealing desk groups have one extra option, "Always send to dealer", which keeps sending orders to the dealer even when the desk is off.
- The old per-group dealer setting and the "Manual dealing" switch on the Risk screen are gone. The dealer desk switch on the Dealing screen is the one switch.

**Clients**
- "Change group" and "Add account" only list groups that can take accounts.

**Dealing**
- The dealing screen's emergency buttons (halt, close-only) apply to dealing desk groups. Use Trading halt for every group.

# Backoffice 1.0.31

**Profit/loss in the account currency**
- Open profit/loss, margin and exposure are converted to each account's currency, the same way the trading server calculates them. This matters for symbols like USDJPY, EURGBP or GER40.
- A position that cannot be converted right now shows "–" and is left out of totals.
- When accounts in different currencies are added up, each currency is shown separately.

**Dealing**
- Rejecting an order and withdrawing a requote now ask for a reason (kept in the audit trail). Before, both always failed.
- Resting limit and stop orders can be cancelled from the dealing screen, with a reason. The client's terminal updates at once.

**Trade history**
- "Void deal" was removed from closed deals, where it could never work.

**Groups**
- New option "Clients can choose this group at signup". The client sees the group name.
- Saving a group no longer changes its tier.
- The only default group can no longer be unticked, so new accounts always have a group.

**Trading halt**
- The TYPE column shows the group's routing (B-book, A-book, reversal…), the same as the Groups screen.

- The dealing screen's P/L strip now covers open trades plus trades closed since the trading day started. Hedge, market-book (A-book) and demo accounts are not counted.

**Deposits · withdrawals**
- Amounts are always shown as positive numbers. Pending deposits and withdrawals are shown separately.

**Partners and payment methods**
- Changing a partner's rate applies only to trades closed from now on.
- Payment-method fees are marked as information only. They are not charged.

**Signing out**
- Signing out now also ends your session on the server.

Your layout, settings and saved sign-in are kept.

**Clients**
- Moving an account into a group with a different leverage now needs finance rights, the same as changing leverage directly.

**Positions**
- Reversing a position also reverses its hedge and its copied position.

# Backoffice 1.0.25

**Withdrawals**
- New in Settings (CFG) → Withdrawal approval: SINGLE or DUAL.
  - DUAL (default): one admin marks a withdrawal and a second admin completes it.
  - SINGLE: a broker admin completes a withdrawal alone. The Deposits screen then shows PAY OUT, and the audit log records it as a single approval.
- A withdrawal is refused if paying it out would leave the client's open positions without enough margin.

**Transfers and IB payouts**
- Transfers only go between accounts of the same client.
- A transfer that would leave the source account's open positions without enough margin is refused.
- A manager's transfer or IB payout now goes to Approvals for a second admin, the same as a balance adjustment. Approvals shows what each request does: TRANSFER → account, or IB PAYOUT.

**Balance and new accounts**
- A debit can no longer take a balance below 0, or below what open positions need.
- A manager's starting balance on a new LIVE account goes to Approvals. The account starts at 0 until it is approved.

Your layout, settings and saved sign-in are kept.

# Backoffice 1.0.23

**Dealing**
- ACCEPT ALL now fills every order at the live market price, as its confirm says. Before, it filled at each client's requested price.
- The requote +1 / +2 / +3 buttons price a queued close on the side it actually trades. Closing a BUY position sells at the bid, so +N now moves the price down, against the client.
- The ⚙ dealer settings save only the requote step. They no longer clear the broker's max slippage.
- A dealer accept is now refused if the client's account can't cover the margin, the same check as a direct order. An order that reduces margin (a hedge) always goes through.

**Clients**
- RISK LIMITS opens on the account's current swap-free and max daily loss, and saves only what you change. Before, saving it could clear the daily-loss limit and turn "group default" into NO.

**Account types**
- Pricing left blank on a type now shows as "inherit": the group's pricing applies. New types no longer start with explicit zeros.

Your layout, settings and saved sign-in are kept.

# Backoffice 1.0.18

**Margin level matches the server and the terminal**
- Dashboard, Risk, Margin, Wallets and the coverage account now keep the margin level in step with what the server's risk monitor computes, between refreshes as well. Used margin now moves with the price too, not only equity.

- Double-click a symbol to edit it in a dialog with a live preview (for example "raw 13 pts → client spread 30 pts"). After saving, the message confirms what the server stored.

- "Accepts" is now called **Account mode** (which accounts may join: live, demo or both).
- **Dealer** is shown directly for Dealing desk groups. For A-book and B-book groups it sits under **Advanced dealing options** (it still works there, and a group that already has a setting opens with it visible).
- New: **Allowed symbols…** in a group's menu. Restrict a group to chosen symbols, or let it trade every enabled symbol.
- Fixed: switches in the edit dialogs could be clicked only once.

Nothing else changes: your screens, settings and saved sign-in are kept.

# Backoffice 1.0.14

**Auto-hedge: cover every fill automatically**
- New switch in **Dealer mode**, beside auto-fill. With the desk in **auto-fill** and **auto-hedge on**, every dealing-group fill is mirrored onto the coverage account **at the same price, in the same moment**, and that leg closes by itself when the client closes. No one has to click Book now.
- With auto-hedge **off**, auto-filled trades stay on the internal book, as before.
- With the desk in **dealer review**, auto-hedge stands aside: the dealer accepts each order and books the hedge by hand. The two can never both cover the same trade.
- Turning it on does not hedge positions that are already open, and turning it off does not close legs that are already on. If a hedge cannot be opened, the trade still stands and you get a notification saying that one is unhedged.

**Who closes a coverage leg**
- Whoever opened it. A leg **auto-hedge** opened follows the client's close automatically. A leg **you booked** with Book now stays open when the client closes, and the Smart Dealer Manager shows it as **AWAITING DEALER** with what it is worth against that order, for you to close. An auto-hedged leg that somehow outlives its client is flagged **ORPHAN**.
- Closing a position that was never booked is unaffected by any of this: it follows the normal dealer-review queue, exactly like before.

**Smart Dealer Manager**
- **Dealer P/L** now has a range: **1D · 5D · 7D · 1M**, and the header says which window the number covers. Open and booked are live; the range applies to the closed side.
- The breakdown line under it (open · booked · closed) is smaller and no longer competes with the tables.

**Coverage Account**
- The account strip (balance, equity, floating, free, margin level) moved to the **bottom** of the panel, under the legs.
- The table now has **column lines**, so a value is never read against the wrong heading.
- The columns follow the panel width: on a narrow panel the reference columns (ticket, opened, opening) step aside so account, symbol, side, lot, price and P/L stay readable. Drag the divider wider and they come back.
- Margin level with no open legs reads **none used** instead of "no legs".

**Dealer mode panel**
- **Max slippage** is now stated once, with its unit and where it comes from: "10 pips" when you have set one, or "5 pips · platform default" when you have not. That is why Settings could look empty while the desk showed a number: blank means the platform's own 5-pip fallback, not "no limit". **Edit** it right there (0 rejects any slippage at all).
- **Execution** reads "Manual review" or "Auto-fill". **Smart dealer** reads "Off", or "accept ≤ 0.5% · reject ≥ 2%", instead of "off off".

**Emergency panel is the dealing group's, not the broker's**
- The panel on the dealing screen now acts on **the dealing group only**: **Halt dealing group**, **Close-only** and **Resume** apply to your dealing groups and leave every other group trading. It is titled **EMERGENCY · DEALING GROUP** and shows their current state (Trading / Halted / Close-only) in the header.
- Previously these three were broker-wide, so stopping your own book stopped every client on the platform.
- The broker-wide halt still exists, where it belongs: the **Trading halt** screen, which also carries the per-group and per-symbol lists.

**Order ticket**
- A **Type** row (Market / Limit / Stop), and the buttons follow it: **Sell limit / Buy limit**, **Sell stop / Buy stop**.
- The note under them is one short line, and limit and stop say plainly that they need the coverage bridge.

**Shorter wording**
- **Book now** asks "Hedge XAUUSD SELL 1.50 to coverage? (client position stays open)". **Book all** is equally short.
- Empty panels say **None** instead of a sentence; the tables say "No open trades", "No exposure", "No open coverage legs".

# Backoffice 1.0.13

**Coverage stop-outs are no longer silent**
- When the coverage account runs out of balance and a coverage position is stopped out, the desk now hears it: an alarm tone and an on-screen alert the moment it happens, plus a **Coverage stop-out** notification on the bell. The client position that leg was hedging is released back to the Smart Dealer Manager as unbooked, so it can be booked again once the account is funded.
- Every stop-out on any account now raises a notification. Earlier builds closed the position and told nobody.

**Coverage account**
- The panel is now **Coverage Account** (it was "Coverage Journal") and shows the account itself above the Trades / Exposure / History views: **balance, equity, floating, free margin and margin level**, with the level coloured against the account's own stop-out threshold and an **UNFUNDED** warning when the balance is zero with legs open.

**Smart Dealer Manager**
- **Dealer P/L** is the first thing in the panel, large, with its breakdown (open risk · booked · closed) beneath it.
- **Book All** in the panel header hedges every unbooked position in one go, the way Accept All fills the queue.
- Three sections instead of one list: **Unbooked** (as before), **Booked** (each open client position with its client P&L, the coverage leg's P&L and the net, with **Unbook**), and **Closed**, the closing side: recently closed booked trades with the client's realized P&L beside the coverage leg's. A leg still open after its client closed is marked **ORPHAN** with a Close button.

**Book Now follows the client**
- A booked position's coverage leg now closes by itself when the client closes theirs (in proportion on a partial close). If the desk had already closed the leg, nothing happens. The leg's close appears in Dealing Activity and as a quiet toast.

**Chart**
- Only the coverage account's own legs are drawn on the chart. Accepted client trades are no longer overlaid.

**Order entry from the desk**
- The Order Ticket's **SELL / BUY** and the chart's **one-click** widget place a market order on the coverage account at the live price, with optional SL / TP, confirm first (one-click ON skips the confirm, as in the terminal). Limit / stop orders at a price are not available yet: they wait for the coverage bridge.

**Dates**
- Every typed date range (Dealing-group History, Coverage History, Reports) is now a calendar picker: click the day, or still type it. A pick applies the range at once.

---

This build pairs with the web release that carries the server side of the same work (coverage follow-through, stop-out notifications, the dealer order endpoint). Install both together.

# Backoffice 1.0.10

> **Requires the paired web deploy.** The Groups and Dashboard screens read
> fields (`category`, `modeRestriction`, `groupCategory`, `symbolConfigCount`)
> that only exist once the Stage 4 web commits are live, and the Symbols screen
> stops sending `defaultBookType`, which the current production route still
> rejects as missing. Pack after the web is deployed, not before.

**Groups — routing and mode are separate things**
- **ROUTING** replaces the old **BOOK** column: **A-BOOK · LP**, **B-BOOK**, **DEALING DESK**, plus **REVERSAL** and **COVERAGE · SYS** where a group already has one.
- The routing dropdown offers only the three a broker sets by hand. A group already on REVERSAL (the plugin sets it) or COVERAGE (the system owns it) keeps its value and shows it as *(set elsewhere)*, so opening the form and pressing SAVE can no longer silently re-route it.
- New **MODE** column and **Accepts** field: **LIVE + DEMO**, **LIVE ONLY**, **DEMO ONLY**. Mode was never routing; **DEMO** is gone from the routing choices.
- New **PRICING** column: **Source**, or **Custom (N symbols)**. Editing stays per symbol in panel 2.
- The **Dealer** choices say what they do: **DESK-CONTROLLED (queues when the desk is on)**, **NEVER QUEUE (ignores the desk)**, **ALWAYS QUEUE**. The panel header shows the broker's live desk state, because that switch — not the group — decides whether a DESK-CONTROLLED group queues.
- The dead **Tier** field is gone. The group is the tier.
- Deleting a group that still holds accounts answers **409 · move its accounts first** instead of failing as a server error.

**Dashboard — a client's book comes from their group**
- **BOOK** (declared but always blank) is now **CATEGORY**, filled from the account's group — the only thing that decides where an order books.
- New **GROUP** column beside it.
- **ACT** said *VIEW FUNDS* or *VIEW BLOCKED*; the row opens Client 360 and never touched funds. It is one verb, **OPEN**, and status moved to its own **STATE** tag (**SUSP**, **CLSD**), blank for an ordinary active account.
- **ALL STAFF** over the activity feed was a chip that looked like a filter and did nothing. Plain text.
- The approvals queue said *no pending withdrawals* on a panel that holds deposits too: **no pending deposits or withdrawals**.
- **LP fill quality** reads **PENDING · NEEDS LP BRIDGE** instead of a measured-looking figure. Nothing has ever been LP-executed.
- Column headers shortened (**CC**, **LOTS**, **MGN%**) and KYC shown as **OK / WAIT / FLAG** so the whole table fits at 1366 without clipping.

**Symbols — DEFAULT BOOK removed**
- The **DEFAULT BOOK** column and its click-to-cycle A/B toggle are gone. A symbol has no book of its own: routing is the account's group. The stored value is left untouched for now.
- **TRADE MODE** was clipping to *TRADE MOD* → **MODE**; **COMM /LOT** → **COMM/LOT**.

**Price feed — the "connected" chime no longer repeats**
- A dropped price stream retried on a fixed short delay and re-announced *feed live* on every attempt, which on a flapping connection played the connect sound every couple of seconds.
- A connection must now survive 5 s before its backoff resets, so repeated instant failures back off instead of replaying the chime. Shared with the terminal.

---

**Not in this build**

- **Account types (ATY)** is unchanged. Removing the screen was proposed on the basis that `AccountType` was only a second view of the groups API; it is not. It is its own table with its own pricing-override level above the group, and production holds 13 rows with 29 accounts pointing at them. Folding it into Groups needs a migration first, not a screen deletion.
- **Broker onboarding** (starter groups + the 16-symbol set for every new broker) is a **web-side** change and ships with the web deploy. It adds no backoffice UI in this build.
- Publishing a group to clients (`isClientSelectable`) has no control on the Groups screen yet; the column is backfilled so current behaviour is unchanged.

# Backoffice 1.0.8

**Dealing — the terminal chart, in full**
- The dealing chart is now the trader terminal's own chart, with every function: OHLC header (LAST / CHG / O H L), timeframes 1M–W, the INDICATORS picker (MA, EMA, BOLL, SAR, RSI, MACD, KDJ, ATR, CCI, WR — each with a settings dialog for period / source / colour / width), EMA 20/50 and SESSIONS chips, drawing tools (trend line, horizontal line, ray, rectangle, Fibonacci retracement) with a colour / settings / delete toolbar on the selected drawing, chart settings (candle colours, grid, last-price line, previous-day high/low, session map), zoom / pan / price-scale drag, crosshair with OHLC readout, previous-day high / low, the candle countdown and a right-click menu.
- **Single or 2×2 layout**: four independent charts, each with its own symbol and timeframe picker, a focus border, crosshair sync and double-click to maximise / restore. Layout, cells and timeframes are remembered.
- **The dealer's book on the chart**: the coverage leg is drawn with SL / TP handles; every dealer-managed client position on the symbol is drawn too. Drag a handle or right-click "Set SL / TP here" to modify (confirmed first, wrong side refused on the spot); double-click the coverage leg to close it; double-click a client leg to open its Client 360.
- **One-click widget** with live SELL / BUY prices, a lot box with − / + and a 1-CLICK ON / OFF switch. Order placement waits for the dealer order endpoint: SELL / BUY, limit / stop at a price and price alerts say so rather than doing nothing.

- The NET strip is a **book exposure summary**: total / covered / open-risk positions and lots, net lots, then dealing-group P&L vs coverage P&L = **dealer net P&L** (the client's P&L is the dealer's opposite side; coverage adds as-is).
- Smart Dealer Manager P&L is coloured and larger.
- Pending queue: ACCEPT offers "at requested price" or "at market"; REQUOTE presets.
- The Dealer Mode panel is terse: one coverage-account row, no explanatory filler.

**General**
- **Single instance**: launching the backoffice again brings the running window to the front instead of opening a second copy.
- Text pass across screens: shorter, consistent labels and messages; panel headers trim their title instead of clipping their controls on narrow screens.
- Closed-position activity is now complete server-side: every close path (stop loss / take profit / stop-out, a trader's close, a manager's close) appears in the feed with its realized P&L.
